title: Rusty Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Rusty Broadsword Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Rusty Broadsword Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} {{Term/Store|Rusty Gear|Rusty Gear|Series, BotW}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 169}}{{Name Ref|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Rusty Gear consists of [[Weapon]]s that were once used by [[Hylian Knight]]s.{{Cite|{{Big|Rusty Spear}}
A rusty polearm likely used by knights from an age past. The spearhead is in bad shape due to prolonged exposure to the elements, so its durability is low.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Rusty Shield}}
It's likely this rusty old shield once belonged to a knight. It still has some defensive capabilities, but its usefulness has been worn down by time.|Inventory|BotW}} Over time, lack of maintenance and exposure to the elements have decayed the quality of these Weapons, causing them to become brittle and lowering their [[Durability]].{{Cite|{{Big|Rusty Broadsword}}
This once-fearsome sword has seen better days. It can do some damage in the right hands but also breaks quickly.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Rusty Claymore}}
A two-handed sword not properly cared for. Although it can be used as a weapon, its durability is very low. Don't expect it to last for more than a few strikes.|Inventory|BotW}} If a piece of Rusty Gear is placed in front of a [[Rock Octorok]] while it is inhaling air, it will swallow the Weapon and pause to crunch it in its mouth. After this, it will shoot it back out as a cleaned counterpart. After being cleaned, there is a 50% chance that the item will be its corresponding item in the [[Traveler's Gear]] archetype, a 35% chance that it will be of the [[Soldier's Gear]], a 10% chance that it will be of the [[Knight's Gear]], and a 5% chance that it will be of the [[Royal Gear]]. As Rusty Gear is made from metal, all Weapons in this series sink when placed in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they do not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s and conduct [[Electricity]], and they can be manipulated through the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. When scanned with the [[Amiibo (Ability)|amiibo]] Rune, the {{BotW}} Series [[Guardian]] [[amiibo]] has a chance to spawn a [[Treasure Chest]] containing a piece of Rusty Gear. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Rusty Broadsword Icon.png|link=]]
